description: USDA's public Section 538 guaranteed loans in one state (file as of October 19, 2026): count, total amount, apartments, tax credit deals, median loan-to-cost and lenders, then loan rows (project, city, lender, closing date, amount, loan-to-cost, units, rents) newest first, paged and filterable by lender or fiscal year.

lender.description: Only loans whose lender name contains this text, e.g. "Bonneville".

limit.description: How many rows to return (1 to 50, default 10).

min_fiscal_year.description: Only loans obligated in this USDA fiscal year or later.

name: list_538_loans
title: Section 538 loans in a state
